# Boomkin

> Your open-source DeFi desk on native Hermes: reviewed skills, bounded research workflows, source evidence and local strategy tests.

The catalog contains 27 workflows, 17 independent Galleon packs and 48 reviewed skills. Provider discovery contains 60 sourced entries; it does not connect or install every provider. CoinGecko is the sole onboarding default. Other harnesses receive portable skills only.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/galleonlabs/boomkin/blob/main/README.md): product, browser demo, installation and first public-data task.
- [Agent documentation index](https://github.com/galleonlabs/boomkin/blob/main/docs/AGENT-INDEX.md): task routing, authoritative artifacts and operating boundaries.
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/galleonlabs/boomkin/blob/main/AGENTS.md): contributor ownership and required checks.
- [Live strategy lab](https://galleonlabs.github.io/boomkin/lab/): local browser simulation with dated or synthetic daily observations.

- [Pinned skill catalog](https://github.com/galleonlabs/boomkin/blob/main/catalog/skills.json)

- [Independent skill packs](https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills)
- [Public release manifest](https://galleonlabs.github.io/boomkin/release.json)

Use the installed CLI help and current source for syntax. A source review is not an authenticated provider test; a simulation or ready-for-review artifact grants no financial authority. Read the linked guide's evidence contract before interpreting a result.
